headline: Former Argentine Economy Minister Cavallo Urges Reserve Accumulation
summary: Former Argentine Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo warned of external risks by 2027 and proposed that the central bank buy at least $15 billion in reserves over 12 months through monetary emission.
why: Argentina's monetary policy and central bank reserve levels are critical determinants of the country's sovereign debt sustainability and foreign exchange stability.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Proposals for central bank currency intervention affect macroeconomic stability.
